description: Run a task in a real browser on a public website: it searches, clicks, filters and reads, then answers. Returns a job_id at once; call browser_agent_status until the run is done. Costs 0.05 XNO per run in Nano via x402 and has no free trial: the first call returns the payment challenge, the second carries payment_block. A run that fails on our side is retried free with retry_of.

payment_block.description: 64-character Nano block hash of your payment. Leave empty to get the payment challenge.
payment_block.title: Payment Block

retry_of.description: job_id of a paid run that failed on our side: starts a new run, no new payment.
retry_of.title: Retry Of

task.description: What to do, in plain language (8-500 characters).
task.title: Task

website.description: The public website to do it on, e.g. arxiv.org.
website.title: Website

name: browser_agent
